stzRegexMaker.setup:
o1 = new stzRegexMaker()
o1.AddWordBoundary(:start)
o1.AddCapturingGroup("digits", "\d+")
o1.AddWordBoundary(:end)

stzRegexuter.setup:
o1 = new stzRegexuter()
o1.Trigger([ "numbers", "\d+" ])
o1.Trigger([ "words", "[a-zA-Z]+" ])
o1.AddCode("numbers", "{ @value = number(@value) * 2 }")
o1.AddCode("words", "{ @value = upper(@value) }")
o1.Process("hello 123 world 456")

stzListexuter.setup:
o1 = new stzListexuter()
o1.AddTrigger(:ListOfNumbers = "[@N3]")
o1.AddCode(:ListOfNumbers, '{ @list + [ :Sum = @Sum(@list) ] }')
o1.Process([ [ 42, "hello" ], [ 10, 20, 30 ], [ 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 ] ])

stzMaterialGraph.setup:
o1 = new stzMaterialGraph()
o1.TakesColor(:warm)
o1.TakesColor(:cool)
o1.TakesScalar(:sharp)
o1.AddNode(:final, [ :Op = :Mix, :In = [ :shaded, :warm, :rim ] ])
o1.AddNode(:rim, [ :Op = :Fresnel, :In = [ :sharp ] ])
o1.AddNode(:shaded, [ :Op = :Multiply, :In = [ :cool, :lit ] ])
o1.AddNode(:lit, [ :Op = :Lit, :In = [ 0.25 ] ])
o1.Emits(:final)
o1.Compile()

stzLinearSolver.setup:
